general_information.Description: International Sea Freight Fowarding is a practice‑oriented course that equips student with the knowledge and skills to manage the full life cycle of sea freight operations. It focuses on how sea ports and terminals, freight forwarders, and shipping lines, and consignors work together to move cargo safely, quickly, and profitably in today’s global supply chains Throughout the course, real cases and examples will illustrate how sea freignt fowarding supports trade and logistics development in Vietnam, helping learners see clear links between theory and local industry practice. By the end of the module, students will be able to design and evaluate sea freight solutions, communicate effectively with international partners, and position yourself for careers with shipping lines, logistics service providers, and sea port operators.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate a broad understanding of international freight and sea transport
Interpret and apply fundamental principles of sea transport planning, pricing, and capacity utilization.
Use core documentation and information required for compliant and efficient sea transport movements.
Recognize key safety, security, and regulatory considerations in sea transport operations.
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.

assessments.Question Type: OP1: Divide the class into 4 or 6 groups. Each group will select a global/ Vietnamese air freight carriers and conduct an in-depth analysis of its air freight operations. The report should cover: 1. Company background and industry context 2. Air fleet (types and roles of aircraft used) 3. Main air freight services offered 4. Operational process for handling air cargo 5. Technologies used to streamline operations 6. Common operational issues and company’s solutions to tackle these issues.OP2 (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal
